items.source: Whether the controller represented by this instance has declared any session attributes through an SessionAttributes annotation.
items.translation: 此实例所表示的控制器是否已通过 `SessionAttributes` 注解声明了任何会话属性。

items.source: request - the current request
items.translation: request - 当前请求

items.source: When a controller annotated with @SessionAttributes adds attributes to its model, those attributes are checked against names and types specified via @SessionAttributes. Matching model attributes are saved in the HTTP session and remain there until the controller calls SessionStatus.setComplete().
items.translation: 当带有 `@SessionAttributes` 注解的控制器向模型添加属性时，这些属性会与通过 `@SessionAttributes` 指定的名称和类型进行匹配。匹配的模型属性将保存在 HTTP 会话中，并保留在该会话中，直到控制器调用 SessionStatus.setComplete()。

items.source: Attributes successfully resolved through this method are "remembered" and subsequently used in retrieveAttributes(WebRequest) and cleanupAttributes(WebRequest).
items.translation: 通过此方法成功解析的属性会被“记住”，并在随后于 retrieveAttributes(WebRequest) 和 cleanupAttributes(WebRequest) 中使用。

items.source:
This is necessary for consistent handling of type-based session attributes
in distributed session scenarios where handler methods from the same class
may get invoked on different servers.
items.translation: 这对于分布式会话场景中基于类型的会话属性的一致处理是必要的，因为在这些场景中，同一类中的处理器方法可能会在不同的服务器上被调用。

items.source: Create a new session attributes handler. Session attribute names and types are extracted from the @SessionAttributes annotation, if present, on the given type.
items.translation: 创建一个新的会话属性处理器。如果给定类型上存在 `@SessionAttributes` 注解，则从该注解中提取会话属性名称和类型。

items.source: Store a subset of the given attributes in the session. Attributes not declared as session attributes via @SessionAttributes are ignored.
items.translation: 将给定属性的一部分存储到会话中。未通过 `@SessionAttributes` 声明为会话属性的属性将被忽略。

items.source: Retrieve "known" attributes from the session, i.e. attributes listed by name in @SessionAttributes or attributes previously stored in the model that matched by type.
items.translation: 从会话中检索“已知”属性，即按名称列出的@SessionAttributes中的属性，或先前存储在模型中且通过类型匹配的属性。

items.source: Remove "known" attributes from the session, i.e. attributes listed by name in @SessionAttributes or attributes previously stored in the model that matched by type.
items.translation: 从会话中移除“已知”属性，即按名称列在 `@SessionAttributes` 中的属性，或先前存储在模型中且通过类型匹配的属性。

items.translation: handlerType - 控制器类型
